verdict.rationale: PayPal Invoicing API/product explicitly supports creating, sending, and managing hosted invoices with a secure payment page, branding, and automatic payment reminders (paypal-docs-4, paypal-docs-22, paypal-docs-50), and the agent-tools inventory confirms send_invoice and send_invoice_reminder tools. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of reminder cadence/customization and no third-party review confirming real-world reliability of the reminder feature.
